2609.19928.title: From "Who Is This User?" to "What Does This Purchase Mean?": A Deployed Pipeline for Semantic User Profiling at Bank Scale
2609.19928.paper_summary: Per-user LLM inference on transaction histories binds the inference budget linearly to user count, which becomes prohibitive at applied scale. We re-cast attribute inference from per-user to per-transaction-pattern. The pipeline runs in three phases: Resolve abstracts item names with optional web grounding, Profile infers attributes for each frequent pattern, and Tag clusters free-text attributes into a queryable database. In Profile, a single LLM call per pattern emits predefined categorical labels, free-text attributes, and per-attribute prevalence estimates. Because inference runs over patterns rather than users, the budget grows with the pattern count rather than the user count. On the public Open e-commerce corpus, the database is statistically indistinguishable from an LLM that reads each user's raw history directly in AUC across the evaluated attributes, and the prevalence estimates carry discriminative signal between positive and negative users. The pipeline is deployed at a major Japanese bank profiling on the order of tens of millions of users, with close to a three-order-of-magnitude reduction in LLM inference targets versus a per-user pipeline. The code is publicly available on https://github.com/CyberAgentAILab/profiling-agent-open-ecommerce.
2609.19928.paper_summary_zh: 每位用戶的 LLM 推斷在交易歷史上將推斷預算線性綁定於用戶數，這在應用規模上變得難以承受。我們將屬性推斷從每位用戶轉換為每個交易模式。該管道分為三個階段運行：解析抽象項目名稱，並可選擇性地進行網絡基礎，配置推斷每個頻繁模式的屬性，並標記將自由文本屬性聚類到可查詢的數據庫。在配置中，每個模式的單次 LLM 調用會產生預定義的類別標籤、自由文本屬性和每個屬性的流行程度估計。由於推斷是基於模式而非用戶進行，因此預算隨著模式數量的增長而增長，而不是用戶數量。在公共的開放電子商務語料庫中，該數據庫在 AUC 上與直接閱讀每位用戶原始歷史的 LLM 在評估屬性上統計上無法區分，並且流行程度估計在正面和負面用戶之間帶有區分信號。該管道已在一家主要的日本銀行部署，對數以千萬計的用戶進行配置，與每位用戶的管道相比，LLM 推斷目標減少了近三個數量級。代碼已公開在 https://github.com/CyberAgentAILab/profiling-agent-open-ecommerce。
